name: Aoki Yuji
source: Joins the Forum on the Case Against Uniform Abolition because he misunderstood it as a gathering of people in favor of uniform optionalization and tries to escape. He may have witty responses when spoken to, but he’s often just panicking inside and is too cowardly to let others know what he really thinks. Just wants an ordinary student life, but gets caught up in the commotion often.
